meta.title: map surfaces (karty avraam/ishod, /map/) and the 3-D baptizm app
meta.build: production-like local dist, 108 HTML pages, 94 MB

source: karty/_engine/map-engine.js:3752 renders the intro title as h2
a1b_avraam_source.impact: after entering the map the page has no level-1 heading and all 12 remaining headings are sr-only; the removal comment assumes the engine renders a title, but the engine renders h2 and only inside the intro

a2b_axe_cause.cause: axe Yh() passForModal: a position:fixed element >=75% of the viewport (map stage 1440x900) covering five sample points makes axe treat the page as a modal dialog; page-level rules then pass
a2b_axe_cause.cache_note: axe caches isModalOpen on the first run, so a rerun after removing the element still passes
a2b_axe_cause.implication: on /karty/* axe cannot confirm page-level semantics; judge by DOM and the Chrome AX tree

a3a_karty_svg.note: ishod has a <title>, but it names the basemap, not the interactive route; neither SVG carries role/aria-label

/map/.aria_label: Интерактивный Атлас исследований. Используйте колесо или кнопки масштаба, чтобы приблизить карту.

a3b_map_reference.note: /map/ is the in-product reference pattern for a keyboard-operable map

b1_head_assets.impact: any deployment on another origin (preview, staging, custom domain) resolves icons/manifest/feed to gospod-bog.ru; when the page CSP img-src omits that host the browser blocks them

b2_csp_refusals.other_console_event: mc.yandex.ru/tag.js?id=108353327 -> net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED (sandbox egress artifact, not a defect)

errors: THREE.WebGLRenderer: A WebGL context could not be created
PAGEERROR: Error: Error creating WebGL context
c1b_3d_errors.sandbox_note: WebGL1/2 unavailable in this sandbox with any flags; the defect is the failure path (root wiped), not the absence of a GPU
c1b_3d_errors.entry: the scene opens only through "Войти в 3D-карту"

c2_3d_shell.note: the served shell is an sr-only h1 + header + iframe with no <main>; the indexable prose lives in <noscript>

c3_3d_load.note: the loader is honest and visible for the whole wait; the weakness is weight/latency, not a blank screen

d1_intro_overlay.tab_while_open: stays on the single "Начать изучение" button (underlay inert, one focusable)
d1_intro_overlay.verdict: correct modal behaviour (inert underlay + Escape); the missing role/aria-modal is cosmetic here, not filed

d2a_not_defects.map_scroll_lock: on /karty/avraam and /karty/ishod html/body overflow hidden, body position fixed, scrollHeight 900 = viewport; wheel does not scroll — by design for a full-screen map
d2a_not_defects.me_panel: div.me-panel[aria-modal=true] carries aria-hidden=true and inert; its 4 controls are not in the tab order
d2a_not_defects.photo_modal_img: img.me-photo-modal__img has src="" and 0x0 inside a closed modal

d2b_not_defects.start_journey: the "Начать путешествие" CTA is <a href="#origins"> (in-app anchor), not a dead 3D entry
d2b_not_defects.nav_3d: "3D Карта" is an in-app nav button; the scene opens only through "Войти в 3D-карту"
d2b_not_defects.loader: the outer loader is visible from 0.5 s to 7.0 s; an earlier reading of opacity 0 was taken after ready
